tests.title: Battery power-on reaches Home with readings
tests.objective: Verify that an onboarded device starts from a fully powered-off state on battery power and displays Home with sensor readings.
setup: Onboarding has already been completed.

steps.action: Select Portable mode, then disconnect USB.
steps.expected_result: Portable mode is selected and USB is disconnected.

steps.action: Hold Power until Powered off is fully displayed, release Power, and wait 10 seconds.
steps.expected_result: Powered off and Hold power button / to turn on are fully visible and remain displayed; Go does not restart by itself.

steps.action: Press and release Power. Observe startup for up to five minutes from the Power press.
steps.expected_result: Getting Ready is fully displayed, followed by Home without showing Getting Started. Home shows numeric PM2.5 and CO2 readings and a battery indicator, with no missing text or leftover content from the shutdown or startup screens.
evidence: Save a Home photo. If a refresh stalls or leaves an incomplete screen, capture a video.

tests.title: Menu hold completes onboarding and survives a power cycle

setup: All routes, charts, settings and bonds on this unit are expendable.

steps.action: Disconnect USB. Hold BOOT for at least two seconds to factory-reset, then release. Allow 30 seconds from release for Getting Started to appear.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started is visible after restart.

steps.action: On Getting Started, tap Menu once, quickly double-tap Menu, then hold Menu for about half a second and release. Observe the screen for five seconds after each gesture.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started remains open after each gesture.

steps.action: Hold Menu for at least one second. Release when Home appears, or after 10 seconds from first touching Menu if Home has not appeared. Observe for five seconds after release.
steps.expected_result: Home appears unlocked while Menu is still held. Releasing Menu leaves Home open.

steps.action: Hold Power until Powered off is fully displayed, release Power, and wait 10 seconds. Press and release Power to start, allowing up to five minutes from this press for Home to appear.
steps.expected_result: The device reaches Home without showing Getting Started.

cleanup: Release Menu if still held. If Getting Started remains open, try holding Menu for up to 10 seconds to complete onboarding, releasing when Home appears or the time limit is reached. Record any failure to reach Home.

steps.action: Select Portable mode. Record the serial and installed version from Settings > About Device, and Temperature Unit from Settings > Display & Touch. Open the matching device in AirGradient Dashboard and record its firmware assignment.
steps.expected_result: The device and dashboard serials match.

steps.action: Assign the installed version in the dashboard during preparation. Connect USB and keep it connected through the update. Select Stationary mode and allow up to 30 seconds for connection.
steps.expected_result: Home shows connected Wi-Fi and a charging bolt or external-power plug icon.

steps.action: Replace <serial> with the recorded serial. Send GET http://airgradient_<serial>.local/api/v1/config with No Auth and no body. Record configurationControl, cloudConnection and measurementInterval.
steps.expected_result: All three original values are recorded.

steps.action: At the same URL, send PUT with No Auth, Content-Type: application/json and raw JSON body {"configurationControl":"local"}. Poll GET config every two seconds for up to 10 seconds to confirm the setting has changed.
steps.expected_result: configurationControl becomes local.

steps.action: Send PUT at the same URL with the same headers and raw JSON body {"cloudConnection":true,"measurementInterval":10}. Poll GET config every two seconds for up to 10 seconds to confirm the settings have changed.
steps.expected_result: Cloud connection is enabled, the interval is 10 seconds and configuration control remains local.

steps.action: Select Portable mode. Assign the approved newer version to Go in the dashboard, then select Stationary mode. Observe the update and restart, allowing up to 65 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Updating firmware appears, followed by Restarting and Home. No Update failed message or repeated restart occurs.

steps.action: Check the installed firmware version in About Device. Then check Temperature Unit and the measurement interval in Settings. Return Home, allow up to five minutes for numeric PM2.5 and CO2 readings, then observe for another 40 seconds.
steps.expected_result: The installed version matches the target. The recorded temperature unit and 10-second interval remain selected. At least three measurement updates complete.
evidence: Save the installed version and a Home photo; capture any stalled or failed update.

cleanup: After the update finishes or fails, keep the installed version assigned during restoration.
Restore the recorded measurement interval, then cloud connection, then configuration control using PUT config. Poll GET config every two seconds for up to 10 seconds to confirm each restoration.
Select Portable mode, restore the original dashboard assignment and disconnect USB. Record the installed version and any failure. Restoring the assignment does not restore the previous firmware.
